output.narrative: Leading hypothesis: Capacity loss after CPU 3 failure (p=0.9536), supported by CPU 3 down (OMF 103), PATHMON takeover (1077), ATM-AUTH losing 4 servers, and CPU 5 at 96% busy. ATM-AUTH starved at MAXSERVERS (p=0.0179) is ruled down because 20 of 32 servers are running, which is not at max. Runaway batch process (p=0.016) is unlikely as CPU 5 at 96% is better explained by the CPU 3 failure takeover.
